faqs.question: Do you deliver outside Lagos?
faqs.answer: Yes, nationwide. Delivery fees depend on the state and are confirmed by our team after you order.

faqs.question: Can I return an item?
faqs.answer: You can exchange an item within 7 days if the tags are still on. Refunds are not available on sale items.

faqs.question: Is the dye colourfast?
faqs.answer: Each piece is pre-washed, but we recommend a cold hand wash for the first few washes.
